title: TargetZero admin record
description: One row of an admin CSV. Every admin source (M365, Google Workspace, vendor collectors, manual register) writes this format, so Zero 1 and Zero 2 can be counted across all systems.

system.description: Tenant, domain, device or console name.

account_type.description: service = app, service principal or non-interactive account. Service accounts count for Zero 1 but not for Zero 2.

privileged.description: Y when the role counts as full admin.

permanent.description: Y when the role is active with no end date.
